focus.display: Referral: Surgical extraction (± immediate implant), tooth #30

note.text: This is the ONLY Task for this referral episode — same single-Task design established for UC01/UC02a (one Coordination Task per Request; Task.output absorbs fulfillment artifacts). Unlike UC02a, this Task's focus points at the referral ServiceRequest from the start, because in UC02b the referral is created in Interaction 1 itself (there is no PA cycle preceding it — commercial coverage requires no PA, so no DTR QuestionnaireResponse to focus on). businessStatus is 'referral-sent' at this I1 snapshot; owner is intentionally NOT set yet (it is set for the first time at I2 when Austin Oral Surgery accepts the referral and books the appointment). status is in-progress, not completed — the Task closes only when the referral itself closes at Interaction 4 (not yet built). The ode-referral-sub-status codes here are illustrative/consistent with UC02a's usage of the same CodeSystem. This same Task (same id) is updated, not replaced, at I2.
